In exchange for the shares, a revocable trust, of which the reporting person is sole trustee and beneficiary, transferred to the irrevocable trusts cash having an equivalent fair market value that was determined by the average of the high and low prices of PepsiCo Common Stock on October 14, 2026. || Includes 168,632 shares previously reported as directly owned by the reporting person, which shares were transferred to the reporting person's revocable trust of which the reporting person is sole trustee and beneficiary.

Represents shares of PepsiCo Common Stock acquired from irrevocable trusts established by the reporting person through the exercise of the reporting person's power to substitute assets of equivalent value for property held by such trusts. In exchange for the shares, a revocable trust, of which the reporting person is sole trustee and beneficiary, transferred to the irrevocable trusts cash having an equivalent fair market value that was determined by the average of the high and low prices of PepsiCo Common Stock on October 14, 2026.
